statement.zh-TW: 能依題目指定的版本計算並解讀 ROA、ROE、稅前利益佔實收資本比率、純益率與每股盈餘
statement.en: Calculate and interpret ROA, ROE, the profit before tax to paid-in capital ratio, the net profit margin and earnings per share in the version a question specifies

text.zh-TW: 把 ROA 與 ROE 的分母搞混，用股東權益算 ROA 或用資產算 ROE
text.en: Mixing up the denominators of ROA and ROE, using equity for ROA or assets for ROE

text.zh-TW: 以為 ROA 只有一種公式，不同版本算出來一定相同
text.en: Thinking there is only one ROA formula and every version must give the same figure

text.zh-TW: 每股盈餘直接用股本金額當分母，忘了換算成股數
text.en: Using the share capital amount as the denominator of EPS instead of converting it into a number of shares

statement.zh-TW: 能算出償債能力的三個指標（流動、速動與利息保障倍數）並說明各自的意義，以及流動負債為零時為什麼顯示 N/A
statement.en: Work out the three solvency ratios (current, quick and times interest earned), explain what each one means, and say why the current ratio shows N/A when there are no current liabilities

text.zh-TW: 速動比率忘了把存貨排除
text.en: Forgetting to exclude inventory from the quick ratio

text.zh-TW: 利息保障倍數的分子直接用本期淨利，沒有加回利息與所得稅
text.en: Using profit for the period as the numerator of times interest earned without adding back interest and tax

text.zh-TW: 以為流動負債為零時流動比率是無限大或滿分
text.en: Thinking the current ratio is infinite or a perfect score when there are no current liabilities

statement.zh-TW: 能把一個指標的變化拆回報表上的原因（分子變了還是分母變了），並搭配另一個指標交叉檢查
statement.en: Trace a change in a ratio back to its cause on the statements (did the numerator or the denominator move) and cross-check it with a second ratio

text.zh-TW: 看到 ROE 上升就認定獲利能力變好，忽略分母的權益可能變小
text.en: Reading a rise in ROE as better profitability, ignoring that equity in the denominator may have shrunk

text.zh-TW: 看到流動比率上升就認定短期償債能力變好，忽略可能只是存貨堆積
text.en: Reading a rise in the current ratio as better short-term solvency, ignoring that it may just be piled-up inventory

text.zh-TW: 只看一個指標就下結論，不交叉檢查
text.en: Drawing a conclusion from a single ratio without cross-checking

statement.zh-TW: 能分辨以實收資本（股本）為分母的指標與以資產或權益為分母的指標各回答什麼問題，並知道營業利益佔實收資本比率是延伸指標
statement.en: Tell apart what ratios based on paid-in capital (share capital) answer and what ratios based on assets or equity answer, and know that the operating profit to paid-in capital ratio is an extension ratio

text.zh-TW: 把實收資本（股本）當成股東權益總額
text.en: Treating paid-in capital (share capital) as total equity

text.zh-TW: 以為稅前利益佔實收資本比率是一種資產報酬率
text.en: Thinking the profit before tax to paid-in capital ratio is a kind of return on assets

text.zh-TW: 以為每股盈餘越高的公司獲利能力一定越強，忽略股數不同
text.en: Assuming a company with higher EPS must be more profitable, ignoring differences in the number of shares
